title: Turning off the last Settings sub-toggle collapses the Settings section
custom_preconds: 1. Open Create Role (or edit a custom role).

custom_steps_separated.content: Turn the Settings toggle ON, then turn App Settings ON.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The seven Settings sub-toggles are shown and App Settings reads ON.

custom_steps_separated.content: Turn App Settings OFF (it is the only sub-toggle still on).
custom_steps_separated.expected: With no sub-toggle on, the section collapses: the Settings toggle reads OFF and the sub-toggles are removed.

evidence: UI: turning off the last remaining Settings sub-toggle (App Settings) collapses the Settings section — the parent Settings toggle goes off and the sub-toggles disappear.
